svg.title: Advance simulated business time
svg.desc: The writer requests 120 business minutes at speed 20. For example, business time moves from 03:30 to 05:30 UTC, targeting six elapsed wall-clock minutes. Each batch still generates sales, commits and delivers them, reaches ClickHouse and updates the chart. Delivery may take longer, and trading-day end can stop the writer earlier.

text.tspan: Watch two hours of business time faster
The writer advances the simulation clock. Each sales batch still has to reach ClickHouse.
The work still happens for every batch:
Delivery can take longer than the pacing target. The writer stops earlier if the trading day ends.
